gloss: from partway through; from the middle (of)

definitions.gloss: from partway through; starting from the middle; from partway along
definitions.explanation: A set phrase meaning 'starting from some point partway through' something — an event, a story, a route, a process, or a period. Combines the noun {途中|とちゅう} (on the way; partway) with the starting-point particle から (from).

examples.japanese: {途中|とちゅう}から{雨|あめ}になった。
{映画|えいが}は{途中|とちゅう}から{面白|おもしろ}くなった。
examples.english: The movie got interesting partway through.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}を{途中|とちゅう}から{聞|き}いたので、{意味|いみ}がよく{分|わ}からなかった。
examples.english: I started listening to the story partway through, so I couldn't really follow it.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}に{遅|おく}れて、{途中|とちゅう}から{参加|さんか}することになった。
examples.english: I was late to the meeting, so I ended up joining partway through.

notes:
A common fixed expression meaning 'from partway through (something)'. Formed by attaching the starting-point particle から to {途中|とちゅう} (on the way, midway). Used for anything with a temporal or spatial progression — stories, events, journeys, processes.

USAGE:
When speakers want to indicate that some change or action began at a point after the start of something rather than at the beginning. Frequently used with change-of-state verbs ({雨|あめ}になる, {面白|おもしろ}くなる) and with verbs of joining or watching ({参加|さんか}する, {見|み}る, {聞|き}く).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {途中|とちゅう}から{参加|さんか}する: to join partway through
- {途中|とちゅう}から{見|み}る / {聞|き}く: to start watching / listening partway through
- {途中|とちゅう}から{雨|あめ}になる: to start raining partway through
- {途中|とちゅう}から{道|みち}が{狭|せま}くなる: the road gets narrower partway along
- {途中|とちゅう}から{話|はなし}が{変|か}わる: the topic shifts partway through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {途中|とちゅう}で: on the way; in the middle (of doing) — marks a point within the duration; contrasts with から, which marks a starting point. 'I dropped by partway there' would be {途中|とちゅう}で{寄|よ}る, not {途中|とちゅう}から{寄|よ}る.
- {途中|とちゅう}まで: up to partway; as far as partway — marks an ending point rather than a starting point
- {最初|さいしょ}から: from the beginning — the natural antonym
- {始|はじ}めから: from the start — near-synonym of {最初|さいしょ}から
